webster.text: Liability to be sued; the state of being subject by law to civil process.

example.quote: When the question on the suability of the states was depending on the supreme court, he asked whether it had ever been understood that the members of the bench who had been members of the convention, were called on for the meaning of the convention on that very important point;
example.cite: James Madison, Speech in Congress on the Jay Treaty, Apr. 6, 1796
